Name: Doorway chest opener
Instructions:
Setup: Stand in a doorway with your forearms on the frame, elbows near shoulder height.
1. Step one foot through until you feel a gentle stretch across the chest.
2. Keep the ribs down and the shoulders away from the ears.
3. Step back before the stretch becomes sharp.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Wall slide
Instructions:
Setup: Stand with your back and forearms against a wall, elbows bent.
1. Slide the forearms up a short distance without letting the ribs flare.
2. Slide back down to the start.
3. Keep the movement small and easy.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Lat reach
Instructions:
Setup: Hold a doorway or sturdy post with one hand and sit your hips back slightly.
1. Let the side of the body lengthen until you feel a gentle stretch along the side of the back.
2. Keep the shoulder relaxed rather than shrugged.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Seated back reach
Instructions:
Setup: Sit tall on a chair with both feet on the floor.
1. Reach both arms forward and round the upper back gently.
2. Return to sitting tall and open the chest slightly.
3. Stay in a comfortable range.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Sit or stand tall and bring one arm across the chest.
1. Use the other hand to support the arm above the elbow.
2. Keep the shoulder down and the stretch mild.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Arm circles
Instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with the arms out to the sides, below shoulder height.
1. Make small slow circles.
2. Reverse the direction halfway through.
3. Keep the neck relaxed.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Gentle arm extension
Instructions:
Setup: Stand tall and reach one arm forward with the palm facing up.
1. Straighten the elbow only until you feel a mild stretch along the front of the arm.
2. Keep a small bend if a straight elbow feels sharp.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Easy elbow bend
Instructions:
Setup: Stand with the arms by your sides and the palms facing forward.
1. Bend and straighten the elbows slowly, without weight.
2. Keep the shoulders still.
3. Use a range that feels easy.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Overhead triceps reach
Instructions:
Setup: Sit or stand tall and lift one arm overhead, bending the elbow so the hand drops behind the head.
1. Support the elbow with the other hand.
2. Let the stretch stay mild along the back of the upper arm.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Easy arm swing
Instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with the arms relaxed.
1. Swing the arms gently forward and back.
2. Keep the elbows soft.
3. Stay well short of a hard stretch.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Wrist extensor stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Hold one arm in front of you with the palm facing down.
1. Use the other hand to ease the fingers down and in until the top of the forearm feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the elbow soft.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Wrist flexor stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Hold one arm in front of you with the palm facing up.
1. Use the other hand to ease the fingers down until the inside of the forearm feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the elbow soft.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Standing quad stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Stand near a wall for balance and hold one ankle behind you.
1. Keep the knees close together and the torso tall.
2. Stop when the front of the thigh feels a gentle stretch.
3. Switch sides. Hold a support if balance is unsteady.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Split-stance rock
Instructions:
Setup: Stand in a short split stance and hold a wall or chair.
1. Bend the front knee a little and rock your weight forward and back.
2. Keep the heel of the front foot down.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Supine hamstring stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on your back and lift one leg, holding the thigh or a towel behind the knee.
1. Straighten the knee only until the back of the thigh feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the other leg resting and the low back comfortable.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Hip hinge reach
Instructions:
Setup: Stand with soft knees and your hands on your thighs.
1. Hinge the hips back a short distance, as if closing a door with your hips.
2. Stop before the back wants to round hard.
3. Return to standing tall.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Figure-four glute stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on your back with both knees bent, then cross one ankle over the opposite thigh.
1. Draw the uncrossed thigh toward you only until the hip feels a gentle stretch.
2. Keep the head down and the breath quiet.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Knee hug
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
1. Hug one knee toward the chest without pulling hard.
2. Keep the other foot on the floor.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Wall calf stretch
Instructions:
Setup: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and both feet pointing forward.
1. Bend the front knee and keep the back heel down until the calf feels a mild stretch.
2. Keep the back knee soft.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Ankle circles
Instructions:
Setup: Sit or stand and lift one foot just off the floor, holding a support if you need it.
1. Circle the ankle slowly.
2. Reverse the direction halfway through.
3. Switch sides.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Gentle abdominal opener
Instructions:
Setup: Lie on your front with your hands under your shoulders.
1. Press the floor just enough to lift the chest a small amount, keeping the hips down.
2. Stop if the low back pinches.
3. Lower back down and rest.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.

Name: Easy cat-camel
Instructions:
Setup: Start on hands and knees with the hands under the shoulders.
1. Round the back gently, then return to a neutral spine.
2. Let the belly relax toward the floor only a little, without forcing the low back.
3. Move slowly between the two positions.
Breathing: Keep the breath slow and quiet.
Move slowly and stay short of pain.
